picked.t: The Telegraph features Ha Long Bay in Southeast Asia winter travel guide
picked.body: The Telegraph featured an image of Ha Long Bay in Quang Ninh Province at the top of an article recommending Southeast Asian destinations for winter holidays in 2026. Published on Nov. 8, the article "Why this is the perfect year for a winter-sun escape in South-East Asia" was written by travel journalist Lee Cobaj. Its accompanying image of the bay carried the caption: "Vietnam's Ha Long Bay is one of South-East Asia's many natural wonders." Vietnam appeared in the newspaper's "Best for adventure" category, with recommendations for cruises aboard traditional wooden boats through Ha Long Bay, a UNESCO World Heritage Site known for its limestone islands and caves. In the final months of the year, cooler temperatures and occasional mist create a different atmosphere from the summer season, with limestone formations rising above the water. Beyond cruises, visitors can explore attractions, accommodation and entertainment options, particularly in the Bai Chay area. Ha Long International Cruise Port serves as a departure point for bay tours and provides access to nearby resorts and attractions. Accommodation includes Oakwood Ha Long, a waterfront property. The Queen Cable Car at Sun World Ha Long crosses Cua Luc Bay to Ba Deo Hill, offering panoramic views of Bai Chay Bridge, surrounding mountains and the coastline. At the hilltop, visitors can explore the Japanese Garden and Bao Hai Linh Thong Tu pagoda complex, which also offers views of the bay. In the evening, Bai Chay offers dining, shopping and entertainment along the waterfront. VUI-Fest Ha Long, a seaside night market near the lighthouse, features food stalls, souvenir shops and other activities. Nearby, Sun Bavaria Ha Long serves craft beer and grilled dishes alongside music. Away from the coast, Quang Hanh offers hot mineral springs among forested hills. Hilton Quang Hanh Onsen Resort features Japanese-inspired bathing facilities, including outdoor pools and private onsen spaces where visitors can soak in naturally heated water. According to analyses cited by the resort, the mineral water contains about 40.42-45.31 milligrams of bromine per liter. The resort also offers mineral bathing pools and villas with private onsen facilities for visitors seeking a quieter stay after exploring the bay. The Telegraph 's feature highlights Ha Long Bay's international profile and the range of experiences available in the area. Alongside its UNESCO-listed landscape, the destination offers cruise facilities, cable cars, waterfront entertainment and mineral spring resorts. Several of these tourism and hospitality developments are associated with Sun Group, which has invested in attractions and accommodation in Quang Ninh Province.

picked.t: Forbes lists Da Nang among destinations for retirement abroad in 2026
picked.body: U.S. magazine Forbes has included Vietnam for the first time in its annual list of the best places to retire abroad, naming Da Nang and Hoi An among 96 destinations across 24 countries. In its article, "The Best Places To Retire Abroad In 2026," Forbes assessed locations based on living costs, healthcare, safety and quality of life. The magazine described Vietnam as an affordable tropical destination, highlighting its cultural attractions, beaches, dining options and relatively low rate of serious crime. Living costs are approximately one-quarter of those in the U.S., it said. Forbes highlighted Da Nang for its long sandy beaches and mix of coastal scenery, outdoor activities and urban amenities. Residents and visitors can take sunrise walks along My Khe Beach, explore the mountains at Ba Na Hills or spend evenings along the Han River. At Sun World Ba Na Hills, cable cars carry visitors to nearly 1,500 meters above sea level, where temperatures are cooler than along the coast. The mountain attraction features the Golden Bridge, supported by two giant hand-shaped structures, as well as the French Village and Moon Castle. The French Village offers accommodation, dining and entertainment, including coffee and pastries at Eric Kayser, Fantasy Park and the Alpine Coaster. Another attraction is the Son Tra Peninsula, known for its forested mountains and coastal scenery. Along Bai Bac Bay, the InterContinental Danang Sun Peninsula Resort, designed by architect Bill Bensley, offers accommodation amid the natural landscape. The resort was named Asia's best in the 2026 Readers' Choice Awards by Condé Nast Traveler, based on reader votes. In the city center, restaurants, cafes, shops and cultural venues line the Han River waterfront, one of Da Nang's main gathering areas. Bridges, riverside promenades and entertainment venues attract visitors throughout the day. Novotel Danang Premier Han River offers views of the waterfront and access to nearby dining and entertainment. Da Nang also hosts major annual events, including the Da Nang International Fireworks Festival (DIFF), which brings international teams to the Han River for competitions accompanied by cultural and entertainment activities. Travel + Leisure Asia included DIFF in its 2026 list of nine summer festivals worldwide worth experiencing. The 43-day festival attracted more than 2.72 million overnight visitors, up nearly 45% from the previous year, according to the Da Nang Department of Culture, Sports and Tourism. Forbes 's guide also noted that Vietnam does not offer a formal retirement visa, an important consideration for foreigners planning to stay long term. The inclusion reflects international interest in Vietnam's affordability and lifestyle options. For Da Nang, beaches, cultural attractions, resorts and year-round events offer a range of experiences for visitors and prospective long-term residents.

picked.t: Vietnam's 100 best places to work in 2026
picked.body: The rankings, released on Wednesday by recruitment consultancy platform Anphabe, were based on a survey of 70,000 workers who assessed more than 713 companies in 18 industries. The Vietnam Chamber of Commerce and Industry supported the survey. Food producer Nestlé climbed to first place after ranking in the top 10 last year. Cosmetics company L’Oréal took the top spot among midsized firms for the first time. Last year, it ranked among the top 20 large companies. Anphabe also ranked best places to work by industry. Vietnam's largest listed company Vingroup and its subsidiaries ranked first in five industries, including services and tourism, while military-run Viettel Group led in information technology and telecom infrastructure. Newcomers to this year's midsize company list included Viet Uc Seafood Group and National Citizen Bank. Anphabe's methodology for evaluating workplaces used a five-stage model of talent attraction. It measured the strength of an employer’s brand by tracking applicants’ awareness of the company, their interest in it, whether they apply for a job, their desire to work there, and whether they would choose it over other employers. The platform also gathered feedback from employees at companies that opt into the survey. The employees assessed their workplaces against six sets of criteria for an ideal work environment: rewards policies, development opportunities, culture and work environment, leadership and management capabilities, quality of work and life, and corporate reputation. Anphabe advises companies on employer branding and productivity transformation. It has obtained intellectual property protection for "Vietnam Best Places to Work."

1420회차 및 1425회차 추첨결과. (이미지=비엣로트 추첨결과 갈무리) 베트남에서 로또 2등 당첨자가 무더기로 쏟아져 큰 관심을 받고 있다. 베트남 국영 로또사업자 비엣로트(Vietlott)는 지난 17일 파워 6/55(Power 6/55) 1425회차 추첨에서 잭폿2(Jackpot 2) 당첨자 15명이 나왔다고 밝혔다. 당회차 잭폿2 당첨금은 36억5,000만 동(14.2만 달러)으로, 규정에 따라 당첨자들은 1인당 세전 2억4,300만 동(9,458달러)씩을 수령하게 된다. 잭폿2 당첨 확률은 480만 분의 1로, 통상 한 회차에 1~2장에 그치던 것이 이렇게 몰린 것은 출시 이후 이번이 처음이다. 이번 추첨 결과에는 눈에 띄는 대목이 있다. 비엣로트 추첨결과를 보면 지난 5일 진행된 1420회차는 당첨번호 06-20-34-41-49-52에 보너스 번호 36이었고, 17일 1425회차는 06-20-36-41-49-52에 보너스 번호 34가 나왔다. 두 회차에 추첨 번호 7개가 모두 같고, 34와 36만 주번호와 보너스 번호 자리만 서로 맞바뀐 것이다. 결국1420회차 당첨번호와 같은 숫자 6개를 고른 사람은 이번에 잭폿2에 당첨되는 행운을 얻게 된 셈이다. 비엣로트에 따르면, 당첨자 중 3명은 안장성(An Giang) 출신으로, 나머지 당첨자는 호치민시와 껀터, 탄화성(Thanh Hoa), 닥락성(Dak Lak), 빈롱성(Vinh Long), 칸화성(Khanh Hoa), 푸토성(Phu Tho), 타이응우옌성(Thai Nguyen) 등 전국에서 나왔다. 베트남판 로또복권의 일종인 파워 6/55 복권용지. 파워 6/55는 메가 6/45(Mega 6/45)와 더불어 비엣로트의 주력사업 중 하나로, 전체 55개 숫자중 6개 번호를 맞추는 베트남판 로또 복권이다. 1등 당첨 확률은 2898만9675분의 1로, 동행복권 로또 1등 당첨 확률보다 3.6배 가량 낮다. 2등에 해당하는 잭폿2는 5개 번호와 나머지 49개 숫자 중 보너스 번호 1개를 맞히면 당첨된다. 상금은 최소 30억 동으로, 당첨자가 없으면 해당 회차 누적액의 10%가 당첨금에 더해진다. 비엣로트 통계에 따르면 2016년 번호선택식 복권 판매를 시작한 뒤 지난 6월 말 기준 533명이 메가 6/45 및 파워 6/55에서 10억 동(약 3.9만 달러) 이상의 잭폿에 당첨됐다. 당첨금 총액은 약 12조1,800억 동(약 4억7,410만 달러)이다. 이 가운데 400명 넘는 당첨자는 이른바 ‘벼락부자’ 자리에 올랐다. 비엣로트는 베트남 재무부가 지분 100%를 출자한 국영기업으로, 올해는 2016년 첫 상품 출시 이후 처음으로 10조 동(3억8,920만여 달러)을 넘는 매출 목표를 세운 상태다. 비엣로트의 복권 수익은 각 지방정부 예산으로 편입돼 △보건·의료 △교육 △기후변화 적응 △농촌개발 △공공복지 사업 등에 지원되고 있다.
